framework.name: Climate change, sustainable environment and livable cities

Overall objective of the Project is that civil society organisations (CSOs) and public institutions at local level work together on common interests through dialogue and cooperation based on willingness, trust and mutual acknowledgment.
Specific objectives of the Action are:
